title: Beyoncé and the Cost of Controlling the House
audience: Readers who want a citable, data-framed psychological-economic profile of Beyoncé — not fan biography.
metaDescription: A Psychonomics profile of Beyoncé: Hermann LTA scores, Parkwood as institutionalized self, Lemonade’s canon economics, and an 8,000-line lyric machine.
angle: Unlike Caesar (self as institution via patronage), Beyoncé externalizes the self into a firm she owns — control of authorship as the load-bearing wall.
